title: Short allocation reasons to ICCL (SHORTALLOCATION_CM upload)
purpose: ICCL's own short allocation rows, unaltered, each with a reason code (01-08) and the collateral available for it; one line per reason.

columns.name: ICCL row as received
columns.note: every column of ICCL's file in its own order, unaltered

source: ICCL notice 20250603-44 points 1-3: the member keeps ICCL's data as sent and adds the reason code and the new Collateral Available column; several reasons may be given for one record, ICCL sums the amounts; the latest upload of a record replaces the earlier. The two added columns' header names are to confirm. Built from the notice's description, not from a published file layout: ICCL has not published this file's column layout. The broker must confirm the field order, names and file name against ICCL's file description (member extranet) before the first upload.
